title: Meridian Toolkit 4.2: Licence Summary
key_sentences: This page summarises the Meridian Public Licence, version 2, as it applies to Meridian Toolkit 4.2.
The full text of the licence always takes precedence over this summary.
Every source file that you redistribute must keep the header shown below.
The licence tier and the seat count are set in the configuration file of each installation.
Meridian may ask for a seat declaration once a year, with thirty days' notice.
An audit is limited to records that show how many seats are in use.
Questions about this summary can be sent to the licensing desk at any time.

rows: Public forum no response time promised
Email and chat response within 4 working hours
Named engineer and quarterly review meeting
Credit and share-alike for the data

list_items.text: 1. Install the toolkit on any number of machines owned by your organisation.
2. Use the toolkit to build and ship your own products, including commercial ones.
3. Modify the source code and keep the modifications private.
4. Redistribute unmodified copies of the toolkit with a copy of the licence.
- Remove or alter the copyright notices in the source files.
- Offer the toolkit itself as a hosted service to third parties.
- Use the Meridian name or logo to suggest endorsement of your product.
- Transfer a seat licence to another organisation without written consent.
☐ Record the number of active seats every quarter.
☑ Keep a copy of the licence in every distribution.
☐ Send the annual seat declaration before 31 January.
☑ Store the licence key outside the source repository.
